text:
Design notes for the public API.
We protect it with a token bucket per client.
The numbers still need tuning.

turns.question: What does the token bucket mean here? Check the project code.
turns.explanation: A token bucket refills at a fixed rate and allows bursts up to its capacity; each request takes one token and an empty bucket rejects the request with HTTP 429 [1].
